outcome: prevalence of overweight and obesity in pregnancy
cohort: The study included 16,803 pregnant women in the health region of Lleida, Spain, between 2012 and 2018.
finding: The prevalence of obesity in pregnant women increased from 11.1% in 2012 to 13.4% in 2018, with significant ethnic disparities observed in Maghrebi, sub-Saharan African, and Latin American populations, and strong associations between higher BMI and hypertension and gestational diabetes mellitus.
